protocol_settings.path: Original cli_ext.make_evaluator -> NeuralEval.evaluate([state]) -> model.state_values; no RGCN arithmetic rewrite
protocol_settings.input_shape: one graph per actual model invocation, regardless of total requested batch
protocol_settings.legacy_difference: original GPU/chunk48 changed to CPU/native single-state; historical OPEN revalued only in separate controlled copy
protocol_settings.cache_key: task SHA/domain SHA + full state hex + model SHA + protocol ID; nested namespaces retain full key identity

coalescence.exact: Previous normalized full content; SHA candidate then actual content equality
coalescence.future: Exclude only below nondecision statistics; preserve all other fields; sort heap logical entries, preserve actual serial values and counter; retain stale entries
coalescence.exclusions_justification: These are recorded statistics, not action/score/queue decision inputs in frozen step; external consumed resource costs and budget remainder reported separately. No claim of equal remaining wall time or remaining bounded budget.
coalescence.scope: All saved complete A/B checkpoints, including cross-depth pairs; initial (0,0) excluded; no match means only no observed coalescence

decision_rules.repeat: Actual complete content equality in common prefix. Wall-only length differences are censored, not automatic errors.
decision_rules.window: All four common complete prefix; exclude intervention step for subsequent effects
decision_rules.complete: delta_E=E_B-E_A; delta_L=L_B-L_A; require repeat validity and all four legal solutions
decision_rules.Struct_threshold: Old 20 percent and 5 expansions canceled before outcome. Report every nonzero delta; no posthoc threshold
decision_rules.incomplete: Interrupted expansion retained separately, not counted complete; resource requests still fully charged
decision_rules.score_consistency: Audit observed values only; never provides cross-branch values; same key bytes mismatch stops related event
decision_rules.timing: Deadline begins immediately before first pop after restore. Inclusive guard uses elapsed time including logging. SIGALRM inside step; checkpoint writing is separate record time. No new search after deadline; detection latency and last complete search end are reported.
decision_rules.cache: Fresh deserialize original cache per slot; evaluator task/model lifecycle same G2; observational registry never used for inference
